_comment: Input Activity (Keylog) module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_consent_note: Agent MUST show a visible permission popup and on-screen indicator before sending any keylog data. Controller only renders what the Agent voluntarily sends.

keylog_start._desc: Request agent to start capturing and sending keyboard events (requires user consent on Agent side)

keylog_stop._desc: Request agent to stop sending keyboard events

keylog._desc: Batch of keyboard events pushed by the agent

keylog_started._desc: Agent confirms keylog is active (user granted consent)

keylog_denied._desc: Agent reports that the user denied the consent popup
